definitions.aggregation: First mean of both DDIM seeds for each recording/regime/model/arm, then equal recording within dataset; macro means three dataset means equally. Combined observation regime additionally averages clean/noisy within recording. Counts are single-source opportunities, not doubled by DDIM seeds.
definitions.bootstrap: Descriptive recording-paired percentile 95% CI, fixed RNG2026101807,10000 draws; one trained model realization and one fixed window per recording, not independent training replication. No extra adoption threshold or multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim.
definitions.foot_speed: Prediction XZ horizontal speed on intervals selected by GT 3D foot-joint speed<0.2m/s; opportunity mask fixed across models/arms/seeds. Not a direct ground-contact or sliding measure.
definitions.foot_height: Absolute foot-joint Y error versus GT over all192frames and both feet; low-speed variant separately shown. Neither is penetration rate, support clearance or full-mesh physical correctness.
definitions.head: Distance to observed input head position, valid meta[:,15,0]>0 & meta[:,15,2]>0; binding registered guard applies only RICH and equal-dataset macro, each regime, not individual EgoBody.
definitions.scene: Same model/checkpoint, camera, observation/reference, missing masks and DDIM seed; learned_only minus none, analytical physical guidance OFF in both. Includes learned global/local scene and local feedback pathways.
definitions.holdout: All43 includes dev12 inspected at1000. Confirmation31 =RICH23/Trumans4/EgoBody4 first inspected at fixed3000; descriptive subset only, no new threshold.

limitations: Not the complete set of VAL windows or official TEST metrics. RICH covers27 eligible validation recordings of28; excluded165-frame sequence is shorter than192-frame model input.
Fresh CPU source GT/rest/observations are exact; CPU reconstructed floating reference is checked by tolerance. Do not call all CPU/GPU known tensors bit-exact.
Formal fusion pass/reject comes only from frozen ACCEPTANCE.json and DECISION.json. Control-vs41k and scene ablations are descriptive evidence, never recast as formal fusion acceptance.
No automatic model promotion, extra training, threshold changes, asset deletion or main REPORT modification.
interpretation: The frozen fusion decision is reject; fusion is not supported over matched control or base41k by this experiment. Do not promote automatically.

Control continuation has small descriptive RICH World mean improvement, with all/clean/noisy and confirmation95% intervals including zero. This does not establish a RICH World advantage over41k. PA/foot/acceleration point means improve; see dataset/regime tables and head risks rather than World ranking alone.

Control and fusion scene-on/off each show large paired gains in World, PA and root-relative metrics while physics isOFF. This supports the existing learned scene inference pathways on this fixed cohort; it does not establish an incremental fusion architecture contribution.

EgoBody noisy control-input-head error regresses1.0993mm versus41k on all8, but improves0.4563mm on confirmation4. This is a descriptive single-dataset risk, not a change to the registered RICH+macro head-guard scope.
